title: SALTO Compatible RFID Hotel Key Cards — DESFire-First Security Matrix
summary: ProudTek RFID cards are fully compatible with SALTO hotel locks across the XS4 One, XS4 Original+ and Ælement series using MIFARE DESFire, MIFARE Ultralight C and ISO/IEC 14443-compliant credentials. SALTO stands apart from other premium lock manufacturers by making MIFARE DESFire its primary credential standard rather than a legacy option, reflecting a security-first approach to hotel access control. The compatibility matrix on this page maps every current SALTO lock series to its supported chip families, mobile credential integration and software platform. Properties running SALTO SPACE on-premises or SALTO KS cloud-based access control can specify DESFire 2K or 4K for enterprise-grade AES-128 encryption and mutual authentication, while Ultralight C remains available for cost-optimized deployments. The XS4 One additionally integrates BLE and NFC for seamless mobile key support through SALTO SPACE Mobile Access. Each chip-lock combination listed below has been verified through ProudTek bench testing using SALTO reference encoders and SALTO SPACE integration workflows, with firmware-specific encoding validation and on-site compatibility assurance. Request a free test-card kit to validate compatibility with your specific SALTO lock hardware and software version before committing to production volumes.

faq.question: Why does SALTO prefer MIFARE DESFire over MIFARE Classic 1K?
faq.answer: SALTO's security architecture prioritizes AES-128 encryption and mutual authentication, which DESFire provides natively. MIFARE Classic 1K uses static data blocks that are vulnerable to cloning attacks using publicly available tools. SALTO's DESFire standard ensures that every card is encrypted with a unique diversified key, and the lock verifies the card's authenticity before granting access. MIFARE Classic is not supported on any current SALTO lock series.

faq.question: Can I mix DESFire and Ultralight C credentials in the same SALTO estate?
faq.answer: Yes. Both DESFire 2K/4K and MIFARE Ultralight C are fully supported across XS4 One, XS4 Original+ and Ælement locks. Some properties run DESFire for guest rooms (for encryption) and Ultralight C for common-area credentials (for cost savings). The lock firmware does not require changes to support either credential type. SALTO SPACE can manage both credential families in the same property without additional configuration.

faq.question: What is the difference between MIFARE DESFire 2K and 4K for SALTO locks?
faq.answer: The main differences are memory capacity and encryption strength. DESFire 2K has 2,048 bytes of usable memory and DESFire 4K has 4,096 bytes. For typical hotel guest rooms, DESFire 2K is sufficient — the extra memory in 4K is rarely needed unless the property requires extensive access-level data or complex multi-property credential chains. SALTO SPACE supports both variants without firmware differences. Cost difference is minimal (typically 5-8% per card), so security requirements rather than memory should drive the selection.

faq.question: How do I enable SALTO SPACE Mobile Access for BLE and NFC phone keys?
faq.answer: SALTO SPACE Mobile Access is a separate module within SALTO SPACE or SALTO KS that must be enabled in your subscription and configured through the administration interface. The XS4 One lock natively supports BLE and NFC when the Mobile Access module is active. ProudTek can provide NFC-enabled card samples during the test phase to validate that your XS4 One locks are properly configured for mobile credential support. Contact SALTO directly to activate the Mobile Access module in your SPACE or KS license.

faq.question: Are ProudTek DESFire cards pre-encoded or do I need to encode them on-site?
faq.answer: ProudTek ships DESFire cards with the correct chip type and antenna tuning, but does not pre-encode guest-room credentials. Room keys must be encoded at your property through SALTO SPACE because it requires real-time PMS data such as room number, check-in/check-out dates and access permissions. However, ProudTek can pre-encode common-area access credentials if you provide the access-group configuration exported from SALTO SPACE.

faq.question: What happens if I use non-SALTO-compatible DESFire cards with my SALTO locks?
faq.answer: SALTO locks will reject any DESFire card that does not match the property's specific AES key diversification parameters. The lock will display a red LED flash and not open the door. In most cases, the card will not even reach the credential verification stage if the antenna tuning or chip initialization is not optimized for SALTO SPACE encoding. Using verified ProudTek DESFire cards ensures the encoding platform and physical card parameters align perfectly.

faq.question: How long does SALTO credential encoding take at the front desk?
faq.answer: DESFire credential encoding via SALTO SPACE typically takes 5-8 seconds per card, compared with 2-3 seconds for Ultralight C. The additional time is due to AES-128 mutual authentication during the encoding handshake. For properties with high guest turnover, Ultralight C can reduce front-desk encoding time slightly, though most SALTO properties accept the small time increase in exchange for the security benefits of DESFire encryption.

faq.question: Can SALTO-compatible DESFire cards be used with other hotel lock brands?
faq.answer: No. DESFire credentials are encrypted with a unique key that is specific to each property's SALTO SPACE installation. A DESFire card encoded for one SALTO property will not open doors at another SALTO property or at any non-SALTO lock system. This isolation is a security feature — it prevents credential reuse across estates and ensures each property maintains complete access control autonomy.

Test-card kits of 5 pieces are available free for new compatibility projects. Volume pricing tiers at 5,000 and 10,000 pieces offer per-card savings of 15-22% compared with smaller orders. Lead time for DESFire cards is 7 days for plain stock and 12-15 days for custom artwork.
